get.description: Requires records.read. Reads a committed attempt bound to its run, journal, accepted plan and validated evidence. Returns frozen step/task identities, dependencies and original collected task observations. Unknown observations remain unknown; engine and business facts do not replace the Host effective run result.

200.description: Committed run/attempt report with frozen steps and validated collected task observations.

409.description: Attempt is unavailable, uncommitted or not bound to the requested run.
